key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 40-55% at $40-$100/bbl (no royalty + low 12.5% CIT + profit gas = highly competitive vs. MENA peers)
75% cost gas cap (maximum 75% of annual gross production for cost recovery)
12.5% corporate income tax (one of lowest in EU; Cyprus standard rate; petroleum contractors pay same rate)
55-70% government profit gas share (R-factor sliding: IOC 45% at R below 1.5; declining to 30% at R above 3.0)
N/A -- Cyprus uses Production Sharing Agreement structure; no separate royalty levy; government take expressed through profit oil share
KRETYK (Cyprus state energy company) up to 10% right to participate; negotiated per block; Cyprus NOC equity structure still developing
